errors.text: The proposed CALPHAD-plus-descriptor-ML intervention does not reconstruct the target DFT/MTP/FEP free-energy methodology and contains no explicit liquid-phase free-energy calculation.
Evidence E2 supports prediction of room-temperature elastic moduli, not melting temperature, entropy of fusion, or heat capacity; transferring that result to fusion thermodynamics is unjustified.
The claimed sub-10% errors for melting properties are not supported by the cited evidence or by a demonstrated benchmark.

Treating Lennard-Jones molecular dynamics as the principal standard baseline is a strawman for modern refractory-alloy melting calculations, which use DFT, thermodynamic integration, and more sophisticated interatomic potentials.
Entropy of fusion cannot generally be established merely by heat-capacity integration without resolving the latent enthalpy and appropriate solid/liquid free-energy reference states.
